market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility. Hot jobs report + oil at $97 create a hawkish Fed scenario, but Trump political pressure and inflation-vs-growth tension limit the Fed's room. Expect range-bound equities with sector rotation (chips → power/energy). Dollar weakness and EM strength continue. Key risk: any Iran/Ukraine escalation could push oil above $100 and trigger a sharp risk-off.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle ($1.3T by 2027) and autonomous vehicle commercialization support tech infrastructure names. Energy transition and power demand are structural tailwinds. US-China trade thaw via Xi delegation could unlock EM and global growth. However, subprime-style debt structures and geopolitical fragmentation cap upside. Favor quality, earnings visibility, and energy/power over speculative growth.
